# One Dark Pro

One Dark Pro carries the One Dark Pro family of dark palettes into Obsidian notes, Markdown previews, code blocks, sidebars, tabs, Canvas, graph view and editor surfaces. With Style Settings installed it exposes the alternate Darker, Mix, Flat and Night Flat palettes.

![One Dark Pro screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/w4t4r/obsidian-one-dark-pro/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "One Dark Pro"
    author: "Donghang"
    repo:   "w4t4r/obsidian-one-dark-pro"
    slug:   "one-dark-pro"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/one-dark-pro"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/w4t4r/obsidian-one-dark-pro"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/w4t4r/obsidian-one-dark-pro/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Bring the One Dark Pro family of dark palettes to Obsidian notes, Markdown previews, code blocks, sidebars, tabs, Canvas, graph view, and editor surfaces. Expose alternate palettes (Darker, Mix, Flat, Night Flat) when Style Settings is installed."
}
```
